reason: Modelled from SparkFun's schematic and the ATtiny85 gateway firmware: command 0x05 returns the 10-bit ADC reading low byte first (1023 dry, lower wetter), 0x00/0x01 switch the LED, 0x03 sets the address; the check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run.
